newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Danubius surges on market sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Danubius surges on market sentiment.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian Danubius Hotels surged to a new record high on Thursday as it rode the crest of very positive market sentiment.
Danubius stocks opened at 3,825 forints, above Wednesday's close of 3,800 forints, and rose to a new peak of 3,950 forints. At 1215 GMT Danubius shares stood at 3,940, up 140.
Traders said the rise was not related to the official announcement that the Competition Office had approved Danubius' takeover of Hungaria Szalloda Rt. @
"The announcement was not a surprise," said Peter Haas of Postabank Securities. "The market is moving higher and as a leading share, so is Danubius."
